# function: mediaconnect_vpc_interface

Builds the ARN for `mediaconnect` `VpcInterface`:

```
arn:${Partition}:mediaconnect:${Region}:${Account}:flow:${FlowId}:${FlowName}/vpcInterface/${VpcInterfaceName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:mediaconnect:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:flow:flow-id:flow-name/vpcInterface/vpc-interface-name
output "mediaconnect_vpc_interface" {
  value = provider::arn::mediaconnect_vpc_interface("flow-id", "flow-name", "vpc-interface-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mediaconnect_vpc_interface(flow_id string, flow_name string, vpc_interface_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `flow_id` (String) Value for `${FlowId}` in the ARN template.
1. `flow_name` (String) Value for `${FlowName}` in the ARN template.
1. `vpc_interface_name` (String) Value for `${VpcInterfaceName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
